analysis: Documentation-only changes. docs/architecture/inference.md head 595-611 (patch seen in file_changes; units 12/13 are unchanged surrounding head text 1644-2222) documents a new GatedDeltaPrefill kernel selection for qwen3_5/qwen3_5_moe/prism_hadamard_qwen35 prompt windows (minT=16): per-process probe of packed/rows kernels, retaining the first that is bit-identical to gated_delta_step, else stock; decode/MTP/masked/short windows remain stock; DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED can keep stock or force packed/rows. docs/provider/cli-reference.md adds the env var row at head line 1741 and bumps the date (line 3). Security relevance: forcing packed/rows bypasses the bit-exact probe, which could alter recurrent state relied upon by complete-checkpoint capture (prefix-cache, T-041) or outputs (T-007/T-027); however the env var is operator-controlled, and the operator is already adversarial per TB-003/ADV-001 with full output-manipulation capability, so this adds no new adversary capability. Whether checkpoint identity/validator binds the kernel mode (so forced-mode states can't be adopted by stock-mode processes across restarts within the same install) is not verifiable from docs; the cache is per-install KEK-scoped, so cross-provider impact is none. No changes to attestation, encryption, authorization, cacheSalt scoping, TTL, or wire protocol. Implementation in GatedDelta.swift was not supplied; integration may confirm the probe is GPU-side deterministic and that forced modes are documented as A/B-only. No regression identified.
